runner: memory-eval run over public MCP stdio
provider_requirement: none; local embedded database, no model, LM Studio, vendor login, API key, or network access

oracle_rationale.assertions: Each expected assertion is an exact multiline substring in the public returned source content (`value` followed by `unit`), matching the current deterministic scorer contract.
oracle_rationale.correction_boundary: The episodes contain repeated values but no explicit claim-level correction marker. The public ingest adapter sends source_type, source_id, content, and t_ref; correction_of is evaluator metadata and is not sent to the product. Therefore overlapping values are expected to remain a conflict. This corpus does not test an explicit correction workflow.
oracle_rationale.time: The prior-knowledge probe uses the runner's recorded revision checkpoint before the third event, independently from the valid-time cutoff.

required_checks: exact bound source IDs and no forbidden source IDs
complete returned value and unit assertions
expected supported/conflict disposition and typed roles
contradiction relation for the two independently sourced conflicting records
prior-knowledge cutoff excludes the third event
frozen_acceptance.timing: Record each scored assemble_context MCP round trip in microseconds and whole-case duration in milliseconds; report min/median/max for the four-case cohort separately from decisions.
frozen_acceptance.interpretation: Small synthetic characterization only. A pass establishes these fixtures and boundaries on the pinned local setup, not population quality, model-agent utility, or a correction feature. Any product change needs a new test exposing an explicit correction in content or through an existing supported workflow.
